title: Turtle nests found in La Union beach towns

blocks.text: CALASIAO, Pangasinan— Four sea turtle nests holding 435 eggs have been discovered along the shores of the La Union beach towns of San Juan and Bauang since the start of this year’s nesting season in October. Local fishermen and residents played a key role in protecting the endangered marine animals. Three nests were found in San Juan, including one laid by an Olive Ridley sea turtle, while another was discovered in Bauang, according to the Coastal Underwater Resource Management Actions (CURMA), a sea turtle conservation protection group.
